goal: Audit all checklist-engine requirements, exact data/source needs and delivered evidence; reconcile both owner-supplied Gantt charts and publish a traceable corrected status report.
why: Advances the Venice lane row for the Cyrus-assigned full repository audit and prevents missing requirements or false completion claims before any gate is considered.
gantt_row: All project stages 0–8; evidence audit only

tasks.title: Create audit branch venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1 and seed docs/venice-audit-v1/PROGRESS.json as the durable fallback
tasks.acceptance: branch_head(venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1) returns a commit sha and PROGRESS.json exists on that branch at that sha

tasks.title: Read spec + both Gantt claim baselines and extract every stage, canonical inventory id and claimed status
tasks.acceptance: Requirements matrix lists every stage 0–8 and every inventory id with its source link and claimed-vs-verified status

tasks.title: Verify each claim against immutable main evidence (source status json, proof summaries, retained artifacts) without trusting catalog rows or green jobs
tasks.acceptance: Evidence ledger row per claim with a main path or blob sha and an explicit verified/unverified/missing verdict

tasks.title: Publish comparison matrix, corrected Gantt visualization and dependency-ordered actionable report under docs/venice-audit-v1/
tasks.acceptance: Files present on the audit branch and referenced from PROGRESS.json, with no changes outside allowed_paths

tasks.title: Add validator script, source-matched test and push-triggered audit workflow on the venice branch, then open and merge the PR to main
tasks.acceptance: Workflow run on the venice branch is green and merge_pr returns a merge commit on main for the exact expected_head_sha
